messages:
maya: opened a PR to tidy up our function-calling examples and add explicit JSON-schema guardrails for tool outputs. main changes: - add schema for create_event tool - update SDK snippets (python + ts) - fix a couple of dead links. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427|github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427>

jordan: thanks — skimmed it. CI is failing lint in examples/func_call.md (looks like a few trailing commas). i'll push a quick fix. :+1:

maya: great. the CI failure is specifically the example JSON block that has trailing commas. also noticed the schema lets duration be string|number; i'd prefer tightening to integer to avoid parser surprises. suggested schema snippet to embed in the doc: ```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"},"duration":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["title"]}```

sam: i can update the SDK snippet to show passing the schema as a plain dict/obj rather than importing an extra jsonschema lib. e.g. python: `client.call_tool("create_event", schema=create_event_schema)` — is that the preferred pattern?

alice: product check: keeping duration as integer SGTM. can we add a short note under "parsing fallbacks" that we attempt an int cast before failing? also would like a tiny CI test that validates the codeblocks parse against the included schema.

jordan: added a tiny test at docs/tests/parse_examples_test.py that extracts fenced json blocks from examples and validates them against their declared schema. pushed to `maya/docs-pr-fixes` branch: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/compare/maya/docs-pr-fixes>
docbot: deploy-bot: link checker: 2 broken links found (old-tooling.md, legacy-invoke.md) — fixed in branch `link-sweep-2026` — @maya do you want a cherry-pick?

maya: yes please cherry-pick the link fixes into my PR. @sam can you also add a TS snippet showing typed schema usage? something like: `const createEventSchema: JSONSchema7 = { /* ... */ }` and a short example `await client.callTool("create_event", { schema: createEventSchema })`.

sam: on it. i'll add both minimal TS + python examples and a one-sentence note about runtime fallback ordering: schema -> cast -> error. keeping the examples intentionally minimal so they fit inline with the rest of the doc.

alice: small ops ask: add a one-line rollback note in the runbook in case these function-calling guardrails cause unexpected prod errors (how to pin model to v1 + toggle `strict_schema=false`).

maya: added a rollback snippet to the PR description and the runbook section (lines ~210-220). also cherry-picked link-sweep changes. ready for final pass. @jordan can you proofread phrasing then merge after green CI?

jordan: will do a quick language pass this afternoon. if CI green i'll merge and notify the release channel.

docbot: ci-bot: all checks passed on 1789012679 — ready to merge when reviewers approve.
